meta.name: balanced
meta.description: Constructive, evidence-based dialogue mode that avoids sycophancy. This skill should be used when the user wants balanced multi-perspective analysis, critical feedback, or rigorous challenge of their ideas. Triggers on "/balanced" or requests for honest/critical/balanced feedback. Supports passive, interactive, tldr, steelman, and decision modes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获得客观多维度的批判性反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要对你的想法进行严谨的批判性分析
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need rigorous challenge of your ideas

howto.what: Claude会以建设性、基于证据的方式进行对话，避免阿谀奉承。它提供多种输出模式（完整分析、互动问答、摘要、最强论证、决策权衡），并遵循四步结构化分析：认可优点、严格挑战、拓展视角、提炼行动。
howto.when: 输入“/balanced”或要求“诚实/批判/平衡反馈”时触发。也可指定模式，如“/balanced tldr 你的观点”。

say.text: /balanced 帮我分析这个创业想法的优缺点
say.note: 触发完整四步分析模式
触发摘要模式，输出3-5行要点
触发决策模式并附带利弊表格

howto.what_en: Claude engages in constructive, evidence-based dialogue and avoids sycophancy. It offers multiple output modes (full analysis, interactive Q&A, TL;DR, steelman, decision) and follows a structured 4-move process: surface merits, rigorous challenge, expansion, and refinement.
howto.when_en: Triggered by "/balanced" command or requests for honest/critical/balanced feedback. Specific modes can be invoked, e.g., "/balanced tldr <statement>".

say_en.text: /balanced Analyze the pros and cons of this startup idea
/balanced tldr Remote work pros and cons
say_en.note: Triggers TL;DR mode, outputs 3-5 line insight
Triggers decision mode with a tradeoff table
